title: Decision-tethered traffic heuristics lab for progressive rollouts
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Explore a novel Console UX pattern that lets operators tether traffic changes to explicit decision heuristics and simulated signals. The prototype shows a timeline-first workflow with a hypothesis card, cohort simulator (synthetic cohorts based on region, model variant, and latency/error distribution), 'traffic tether' visual that pins traffic percentages to trigger conditions, and an integrated rollback triage panel. Objective: reduce cognitive load when composing canaries/A-B experiments and make safety criteria discoverable and testable before live ramping.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive timeline allows adding multiple decision points and attaching heuristics to each point
Cohort simulator can replay 3 synthetic customer profiles and surface metric deltas (latency, error-rate, pct-of-requests)
Traffic tether visual clearly indicates which heuristics are currently guarding a traffic shift and highlights unresolved policy conflicts
Rollback triage panel surfaces recommended next steps (auto-rollback, pause, partial rollback) and links to incident runbook
Prototype flows tested in 3 internal usability sessions with measured reduction in time-to-decision vs baseline
